name: Sleigh
piloting: Driving Lore (DC 15) or Nature (DC 17 to DC 25, depending on pulling creature)
speed: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 2 Large creatures or 6 Medium creatures)

items.name: Ice Traverser
items.text: Ice and snow are not difficult terrain to a sleigh, but all other terrains are difficult terrain for it.

items.name: Sluggish
items.text: This vehicle must move twice its length for each 90-degree turn it makes.
